CARDS.TITLE: Resource cards
CARDS.DESC: Each card represents a resource: Food (red, 1), Knowledge (yellow, 2), Energy (green, 4), Technology (blue, 8). Each card family has a letter (A, B, C…). Your wealth = your coins + the value of your cards.

WEALTH.TITLE: The goal: get richer
WEALTH.DESC: Accumulate as much wealth (coins + card values) as possible before the game ends. Rankings reward the richest player, the one with the most coins, the most resources, and the most active trader.

TRANSACTIONS.TITLE: Transactions
TRANSACTIONS.DESC: Any player can sell a card by flipping it (shows a QR code or short code). The buyer scans or types the code to purchase at the resource price. This is how wealth circulates between players.

PRODUCTION.TITLE: Production
PRODUCTION.DESC: Collect 4 cards with the same letter AND same level → press Produce → you get 1 card of the next level + 4 fresh cards. Food×4 → 1 Knowledge. Each production also gives you +1 action token.

ACTIONS.TITLE: Actions
ACTIONS.DESC: Spend your action tokens to interact with other players: find who has a card, give one away, steal one, trigger a conflict… You start with 1 token and earn more with each production.

JUNE.TITLE: Free Money mode (JUNE)
JUNE.DESC: Every minute, an amount of money (the Universal Dividend) is distributed equally to all living players. Card prices adjust with the DU. No bank, no debt — money is created and shared automatically.

DEBT.TITLE: Debt Money mode
DEBT.DESC: You start with 0 coins. You must borrow from the bank to play. Each credit: you receive coins, you must repay the principal + interest within the allotted time.

REPAYMENT.TITLE: Repay or extend
REPAYMENT.DESC: At maturity: repay everything (credit settled), or pay only the interest to extend the duration (you still owe the principal). If you cannot pay → seizure.

SEIZURE.TITLE: Seizure and prison
SEIZURE.DESC: If you default, the bank seizes your cards (at a 33% discount) and your coins to recover the debt. If that's not enough, you go to prison for a few minutes — excluded from the game until your sentence ends.
